scope: Independent read-only comparison of the generated Generic rotation keys and source-derived contact metrics after pass2

importantMetricDistinction: Adjacent-key angular steps above are at60Hz and cannot be directly equated to root's120Hz reloaded-clip maxBoneStep metric. ForearmCorrectionDegrees reports pose deviation from the direct unconstrained retarget, not per-frame motion speed.
remainingVerification: Root owns full-model multi-view visual review and actual Animator playback. The numerical result alone does not establish aesthetic quality or prove all surface contact correct.
